email.activation.subject: UniBooks Account Activation
email.activation.intro: Thanks for signing up for UniBooks! Click the link below to activate your account:
email.activation.ignore: If you did not sign up for this account, please ignore this email.
email.eduVerification.subject: UniBooks Student Email Verification
email.eduVerification.intro: Click the link below to verify your student email:
email.eduVerification.ignore: If you did not request this verification, please ignore this email.
email.passwordReset.subject: UniBooks Password Reset
email.passwordReset.intro: Click the link below to reset your password (valid for 1 hour):
email.passwordReset.ignore: If you did not request this, you can ignore this email — your password will not be changed.
email.emailChange.subject: UniBooks — confirm your new sign-in email
email.emailChange.intro: Follow the link below to move your UniBooks sign-in email to this address (valid for 1 hour):
email.emailChange.ignore: If you did not ask for this, ignore this email — nothing about your account will change.
email.chatMessage.subject: New message from {sender} on UniBooks
email.chatMessage.intro: {sender} sent you a new message on UniBooks.
email.chatMessage.once: You won't get another email about this conversation until you open it.
email.chatMessage.turnOff: Don't want these emails, or want them in another language? Change it in your notification settings: {link}
